__broaden__.εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’) · also in a wish after εἰ γάρ, ’if only (all things) were’ · also in a fear clause after μή, ’lest it be (a god)’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if he were’ (εἰ τοιόσδ’ εἴη) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’who he was’ (τίς εἴη) · also in a negative wish with μή, ’may (no man) be’ · also potential opt. with κε in a relative clause, ’which would be’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’)
__broaden__.οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc./nom. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’ · also neut. nom. sg. as subject: ’nothing’ (οὐδὲν γλύκιον … γίγνεται ’nothing is sweeter’) · also neut. acc. sg. as object of a verb, with a comparative: ’nothing (slighter)’ (οὐδὲν ἀκιδνότερον … γαῖα τρέφει ’the earth nourishes nothing slighter’)
__broaden__.οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also causal conj. after a verb of emotion, ’in that, that’ · also correlative ’such as, as’ (οἷον ὅτε πρώτιστον ’such as when first’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τὸν Τηλεφίδην: ’what a man, such a one as’ (ἀλλ’ οἷον … κατενήρατο ’but what a man he slew’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’of such a kind as’ (οἷον ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ἄγησι ’such as the day he brings’)
__broaden__.οἵῳ: οἷος — of what sort, such as; masc. dat. sg., relative (= ὁποίῳ), agreeing with an understood δίσκῳ: ’of the kind that’ · also masc./neut. dat. sg., relative with a following περ, agreeing with ἀμβροσίῳ: ’such as’ (οἵῳ περ … χρίεται ’such as she anoints herself with’)
__broaden__.τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg., subject of its clause: ’which’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’)
__broaden__.τρέφει: τρέφω — nourish, rear, foster; pres. 3 sg. (of Amphitrite fostering sea-creatures) · also of food, ’nourishes, makes thrive’ (τά θ’ ὕεσσι τρέφει τεθαλυῖαν ἀλοιφήν ’which nourishes thriving fat on pigs’) · also of the earth, ’rears, nourishes’ (γαῖα τρέφει ’the earth nourishes’)
__broaden__.πείσεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid./pass. fut. inf. πείσεσθαι: ’to be persuaded, to be won over’ (οὐ πείσεσθαι ἔμελλεν ’he was not to win her over’) · also πάσχω — suffer, experience; fut. inf. πείσεσθαι (πείσομαι): ’to suffer’ (κακὸν πείσεσθαι ’to suffer evil’)
__broaden__.πηνελοπείῃ: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; dat. sg., dat. of comparison · also dat. sg., indirect object: ’to Penelope’ (ἐρέοντα περίφρονι Πηνελοπείῃ ’to tell prudent Penelope’) · also dat. sg. in apposition to a preceding dative of the person affected: ’(the daughter of Icarius,) prudent Penelope’
__broaden__.ἀνῆκε: ἀνίημι — send up, rouse, stir (to something); aor. 3 sg., the gnomic aorist of a general truth · also simple aorist ’let go, released’, of sleep releasing a sleeper (τὴν δὲ γλυκὺς ὕπνος ἀνῆκε ’sweet sleep released her’)
__broaden__.ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows · also accented before the enclitic τε: σύ τ’ ἐγώ τε ’you and I’ · also accented before the elided enclitic ποτ’ (ποτέ): ἐγώ ποτ’ ’I once’
__broaden__.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’) · also + acc., ’in pursuit of, after’ (ἐπ’ ἀγροτέρας ’after wild (goats)’) · also + dat., ’in favour of, on behalf of’ (ἐπ’ Ἴρῳ ἦρα φέρων ’showing favour to Irus’) · also + acc. of time: ’for’ (ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ’for a day’)
__broaden__.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’) · also = ἔπεστι, accented on the first syllable when it stands for the verb: ’there is (upon)’ · also as preverb in tmesis, placed after its object: ἔπι … ὦρσεν = ἐπῶρσεν ’stirred up (against)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of place: ’on, upon’ (οὐδοῦ ἔπι ξεστοῦ ’on the polished threshold’) · also + acc., postpositive with anastrophe, of place: ’over, upon’ (γαῖαν ἔπι ’over the earth’)
__broaden__.ἴῃ: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ’may go’ · also pres. subj. 3 sg. in a temporal clause with εὖτ’ ἂν: ’whenever she goes’ (εὖτ’ ἂν ἴῃ … χορόν ’whenever she goes to the dance’)
__broaden__.ἱμερόεντα: ἱμερόεις — lovely, charming, arousing longing (ἵμερος ’longing’); neut. acc. pl. (with ἔπεα) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χορόν: ’full of longing, lovely’ (χορὸν ἱμερόεντα)
__broaden__.ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’) · also + subj. without κε, in a general clause: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε τις μνήσῃ ’whenever anyone mentions’) · also + opt., of what may happen in time to come: ’whenever he should’ (ὁππότε νοστήσειε ’whenever he should come home’)
__broaden__.ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — from behind, hereafter, in time to come; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν · also ’behind’, of those left at home, no motion from (τῶν ὄπιθεν ’those behind’) · also with a verb of going, ’off behind’ (ἰὼν ὄπιθεν ’going off behind’) · also ’behind (one’s) back, in secret’ (κακῶς δ’ ὄπιθεν φρονέουσι ’think ill behind (one’s) back’)
__broaden__.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’) · also ὄφρ’ ἂν + opt., ’until … should’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἄγοιεν ’until they should carry’) · also temporal + subj. without ἄν or κε, ’so long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἀρετὴν παρέχωσι … καὶ γούνατ’ ὀρώρῃ ’so long as the gods furnish excellence and his knees are stirring’)
__broaden__.μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’ · also + inf., negating an infinitive of advice that gives the content of a word: ’not to’ (ἔπος … μὴ πάντα μνηστῆρσιν ὁμιλεῖν ’a word, not to mingle in everything with the suitors’)
__broaden__.πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’ · also + gen., ’in the eyes of, with’ (πρὸς πόσιός τε καὶ υἱέος ’in the eyes of her husband and son’)
__broaden__.πέδησε: πεδάω — bind, fetter; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, tmesis with κατά (= κατέπεδησε): ’bound fast’ · also simple aor. with no preverb: ’bound, fettered’ (πέδησε δὲ καὶ τὸν Ἀθήνη ’and Athena bound him too’)
__broaden__.ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc. · also with the adverb ὀπίσσω, ’for the time to come’ (ἔς περ ὀπίσσω ’even for the time to come’)
